description: This file defines the interface for plugins within the WPEFramework, including plugin lifecycle, notification, web, websocket, security, and authentication interfaces. It declares several classes and structs with virtual methods for plugin management and communication.

classes.name: IPlugin
classes.description: Interface for plugin lifecycle management, including initialization, deinitialization, and information retrieval.

classes.name: IPluginExtended
classes.description: Extended plugin interface supporting communication channels.

classes.name: ICompositPlugin
classes.description: Interface for composite plugins with notification registration.

classes.name: IWeb
classes.description: Interface for web request handling and processing.

classes.name: IChannel
classes.description: Interface for raw data channel communication.

classes.name: ISecurity
classes.description: Interface for security validation and token management.

classes.name: IAuthenticate
classes.description: Interface for token creation and security officer access.

methods.name: Activate
methods.description: Notification callback when a plugin changes state to activated.

methods.name: Deactivated
methods.description: Notification callback when a plugin changes state to deactivated.

methods.name: Unavailable
methods.description: Notification callback when a plugin becomes unavailable.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initialize the plugin with the provided shell.

methods.name: Information
methods.description: Retrieve metadata information about the plugin.

methods.name: Attach
methods.description: Attach a communication channel to the plugin.

methods.name: Detach
methods.description: Detach a communication channel from the plugin.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Register a notification with the composite plugin.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregister a notification from the composite plugin.

methods.name: Inbound
methods.description: Handle incoming web request or WebSocket message.

methods.name: Process
methods.description: Process a web request and generate a response.

methods.name: Inbound
methods.description: Handle incoming WebSocket or TextSocket data.

methods.name: Inbound
methods.description: Handle raw data inbound on a channel.

methods.name: Outbound
methods.description: Send raw data outbound on a channel.

methods.name: Allowed
methods.description: Check if a websocket upgrade or request is allowed.

methods.name: CreateToken
methods.description: Create a security token from a buffer.

methods.name: Officer
methods.description: Get the security officer interface for a given token.
